gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Contemporary and tall, Noto Sans Nushu stands next to Wallpoet's bold, commanding capitals. Over a longer read, the sans keeps its terminals far from the stroke body, so lines feel spacious beneath the heavy heading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads clean and contemporary, its tall lowercase bodies looking bolder than they are, with wide gaps in the e. Wallpoet commands attention up top, while the plain sans handles the quiet work.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Wallpoet arrives bold and commanding, with high-rising lowercase and gaps between letters. Noto Sans Ol Chiki feels clean and contemporary beside it, holding curve tails well back so words sit as solid blocks.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-hungari: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with smooth bends and a line where paper shows through between its letters. Large open counters make Noto Sans Old Hungarian the approachable half.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Sharp, tall, and sturdy. Wallpoet carries a smooth, commanding look, and Noto Sans Old Italic follows with almost no gap between x-height and cap height. But shrink the heading and its see-through lines would lose their punch.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-north-a: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with smooth bends and tall lowercase that rises high. Yet Noto Sans Old North Arabian does the approachable work, packing a dense, tall lowercase band with terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Noto Sans Old Permic brings approachable, rounded forms that stay clearly open to the side, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. Wallpoet's bold, commanding heading gives that closeness in size real drama.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Heavy lettering, light touch. Wallpoet earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Old Persian lets its open counters breathe into the white space of a lofty, tall lowercase.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Bold, commanding, and a little see-through: that is Wallpoet, with lowercase rising high. Noto Sans Old Sogdian answers on the page with a tall x-height nearly reaching cap height, and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic is approachable and clean, with open-mouthed curves and chunky, tall lowercase letters. Noto Sans Old Turkic against Wallpoet's commanding, see-through heading makes the strongest quality here a sturdy, friendly weight.
